content: Fixed-length window baselines. We first seek to compare CRAFT to existing, fixed-length window approaches to forecasting. To this end, we implement two such baselines: Awry, which is the state-of-the-art method proposed in BIBREF9 based on pragmatic features in the first comment-reply pair, and BoW, a simple bag-of-words baseline that makes a prediction using TF-IDF weighted bag-of-words features extracted from the first comment-reply pair.
